aaron-reveles.text: (2022) Running for this board as a Peace and Freedom Party State Committee officer, said: 'students in poverty cannot learn until their basic needs are met. I am running because I can bring ideas to the table that will meet not only student's educational needs, but also their basic needs.'

source.title: Peace and Freedom Party: Aaron Reveles for Montebello Unified School Board (2022-10-16)

lizbeth-renova.text: Endorsed by the Classified School Employees Association (CSEA), the Association of Montebello School Administrators, the Montebello Schools Police Officers Association, and the Southern California Armenian Democrats.

source.title: Lizbeth Renova for MUSD Board, District 2: Endorsements

lizbeth-renova.text: Wants stronger campus security and emergency communication, plus a Multi-Tiered System of Support providing mental health services, counselors and psychologists for all students.

source.title: Lizbeth Renova for MUSD Board, District 2: Priorities

lizbeth-renova.text: Pledges to protect Early Head Start and early childhood programs and to 'Fight for appropriate staffing, resources, and support for students with disabilities.'

source.title: Lizbeth Renova for MUSD Board, District 2: Priorities

lizbeth-renova.text: Says teachers and staff 'cannot be expected to do more with less year after year'; wants resources for staff, modern classrooms, reliable heating and air conditioning, and a fair share of district resources for District 2.

source.title: Lizbeth Renova for MUSD Board, District 2: Priorities

lizbeth-renova.text: Supports college and career pathways, career technical education and skilled-trades programs, and investments to close math and reading achievement gaps.

source.title: Lizbeth Renova for MUSD Board, District 2: Priorities
